selected_evidence.requirement: Create the `inventorysvc` system account with the required home and no interactive login.
selected_evidence.summary: Verified the system UID, exact home and nologin shell, home ownership, locked password, and rejected login before and after reboot.
Captured the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered account and home, zero failed units, and running system state.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'inventorysvc='; if getent passwd inventorysvc; then exit 20; else printf 'absent\n'; fi
printf 'failed_units='; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain | wc -l
systemctl is-system-running --wait 2>/dev/null || systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'rootfs='; findmnt -n -o SOURCE,FSTYPE,TARGET /
printf 'data_path='; if [ -e /var/lib/inventory ]; then stat -c '%F %U:%G %a %n' /var/lib/inventory; else printf 'absent\n'; fi

commands.command:
set -eu
command -v useradd
nologin_path=$(command -v nologin)
printf 'nologin=%s\n' "$nologin_path"
test -x "$nologin_path"
awk '/^[[:space:]]*SYS_UID_(MIN|MAX)[[:space:]]/ {print}' /etc/login.defs

set -eu
entry=$(getent passwd inventorysvc)
printf 'passwd_entry=[REDACTED]]] "$entry"
uid=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | cut -d: -f3)
home=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | cut -d: -f6)
shell=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | cut -d: -f7)
sys_min=$(awk '/^[[:space:]]*SYS_UID_MIN[[:space:]]/ {print $2}' /etc/login.defs)
sys_max=$(awk '/^[[:space:]]*SYS_UID_MAX[[:space:]]/ {print $2}' /etc/login.defs)
test "$uid" -ge "$sys_min" && test "$uid" -le "$sys_max"
test "$home" = /var/lib/inventory
test "$shell" = /usr/sbin/nologin
printf 'system_uid_check=PASS uid=%s range=%s-%s\n' "$uid" "$sys_min" "$sys_max"
printf 'home_check='; stat -c '%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a path=%n inode=%i' /var/lib/inventory
test "$(stat -c %U /var/lib/inventory)" = inventorysvc
printf 'password_status=[REDACTED]]]id' >"$login_output" 2>&1; then
  printf 'interactive_login_check=FAIL\n'
  cat "$login_output"
  exit 1
else
  login_rc=$?
  printf 'interactive_login_check=PASS rejected_rc=%s output=' "$login_rc"
  tr '\n' ' ' < "$login_output"
  printf '\n'
fi
rm -f "$login_output"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'failed_units='; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain | wc -l
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
commands.stdout:

password_status=[REDACTED]]]] rejected_rc=1 output=This account is currently not available. 
boot_id=fb2aa416-d036-46d3-aeb8-30c65a01cb34
failed_units=0
system_state=running

commands.command:
printf 'exec_available=yes boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true

set -eu
old_boot=fb2aa416-d036-46d3-aeb8-30c65a01cb34
new_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
test "$new_boot" != "$old_boot"
printf 'boot_change_check=PASS old=%s new=%s\n' "$old_boot" "$new_boot"
entry=$(getent passwd inventorysvc)
printf 'passwd_entry=[REDACTED]]] "$entry"
uid=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | cut -d: -f3)
home=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | cut -d: -f6)
shell=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | cut -d: -f7)
sys_min=$(awk '/^[[:space:]]*SYS_UID_MIN[[:space:]]/ {print $2}' /etc/login.defs)
sys_max=$(awk '/^[[:space:]]*SYS_UID_MAX[[:space:]]/ {print $2}' /etc/login.defs)
test "$uid" -ge "$sys_min" && test "$uid" -le "$sys_max"
test "$home" = /var/lib/inventory
test "$shell" = /usr/sbin/nologin
printf 'account_check=PASS system_uid=%s range=%s-%s home=%s shell=%s\n' "$uid" "$sys_min" "$sys_max" "$home" "$shell"
printf 'home_check='; stat -c '%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a path=%n inode=%i' /var/lib/inventory
test "$(stat -c %U /var/lib/inventory)" = inventorysvc
test "$(stat -c %i /var/lib/inventory)" = 8395685
password_field=[REDACTED]]] shadow inventorysvc | cut -d: -f2)
case "$password_field" in
  \!*|\*) printf 'password_login_check=[REDACTED]]] locked\n' ;;
  *) printf 'password_login_check=[REDACTED]]] unlocked\n'; exit 1 ;;
esac
login_output=/tmp/inventorysvc-login-check.out
if su - inventorysvc -c 'id' >"$login_output" 2>&1; then
  printf 'interactive_login_check=FAIL\n'
  cat "$login_output"
  exit 1
else
  login_rc=$?
  printf 'interactive_login_check=PASS rejected_rc=%s output=' "$login_rc"
  tr '\n' ' ' < "$login_output"
  printf '\n'
fi
rm -f "$login_output"
failed_count=$(systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain | wc -l)
test "$failed_count" -eq 0
printf 'failed_units=%s\n' "$failed_count"
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'post_restart_recovery=PASS\n'
